subject: Agent 02 final: topology-fenced bounded FoldInteractive fallback; delete if direct sensor works
body: Final report persisted at /DuoOpen-AgentBus/swarm/agents/02/findings/final.md (sha256 437169744fce7dd29c057519b4a685035246499b358c8418a5626c8b153b9dbb). Core result: current single DEFAULT_DISPLAY FoldInteractive anchor has physical telemetry blind windows, but the prior dynamic all-display anchor design was already reverted after field correlation with cover black flashes. Do not simply restore persistent multi-display anchors. If FoldInteractive remains necessary, use one transport owner with topology/target generation fencing, exact fresh visible receipts, fast transition-scale stale demotion, and only a bounded candidate-token overlap if a non-churning secondary attach is physically proven safe. Otherwise expose geometry-unknown/held state rather than fake interpolation. If Agent01 proves direct continuous shell geometry across swaps/reversal/power, delete WallpaperAngleFeed/logcat AngleReader and wallpaper-specific RPC/plumbing rather than retaining a parallel authority.
